verdict.rationale: Mistral states that OCR 4 can be deployed in a single container that keeps document data in the customer's environment for residency and sovereignty. The Document AI page also markets secure on-premises deployments. So residency control comes through self-hosting, not through a region choice on the hosted API. Missing for 10: selectable storage/processing regions on the hosted La Plateforme API, documented data-residency guarantees and their details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
